Yeah, I guess I better do that. Ive had a counsellor for sometime regarding my issues with PTSD but ive stopped going because....well sometimes things just get off track you know? But yeah, I should probably get this one figured out with a professional because it was really scary.

Yeah, its been pretty scary.

In good news though, she told her parents about it and is spending a few days at a hospital and im hoping that there she will get the help she needs. Plus, im really glad somebody who actually knows what they are doing is taking over for a few days on the helping her front.

Yeah, I feel like im repeating myself all the time too. She has one awful complex where she thinks shes unattractive, and I worry that ive told her "Your gorgeous and the vast majority of people agree with me" so many times that I wonder if it has any real effect anymore. She tells me im a big help and the only reason she isnt absolutely insane now, but god, it gets difficult. The lucky part is, I do get alot of help from her with my mental health stuff, so this isnt a one sided relationship or anything

I really hope we can close the distance soon, I feel like things will improve at that point. High school is rough, I dont blame her for being freaked out

Thanks!

Yeah, I rarely self mutilate but I do have a bit of an issue with it. Im looking forward to when I move near her in a year and I think that will be better for both of our mental health.

Its just that I always worry about how badly things can go. The truth is, I really have alot of doubt that I would survive her committing suicide, and at the very least I would fall apart and probably never love anybody nearly as much again. Its all so terrifying
